query_text: Where can I find the latest news about the stock market?

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. Answer the user's question using it, then end your reply with a section headed exactly 'Sources:' that lists every source you used as a numbered list. For each source, give its COMPLETE URL beginning with https:// - never just the site name or a bracketed number. If you used a source, its full URL must appear.

message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best sources for finding the latest stock market news:

## Top Global Financial News Websites

**Bloomberg** (https://www.bloomberg.com/) – One of the most respected sources for real-time quotes, in-depth market analysis, and business news. Offers both free limited content and premium subscription services.

**CNBC** (https://www.cnbc.com/) – Excellent for breaking stock market news and live market coverage. Also offers CNBC Pro for premium analysis and live TV streaming.

**Reuters** (https://www.reuters.com/) – Provides comprehensive global market coverage with extensive data and analysis tools.

**Financial Times** (https://www.ft.com/) – Internationally recognized for accuracy and authority in financial reporting, with excellent market data sections.

**The Wall Street Journal** (https://www.wsj.com/) – Renowned for economic news and in-depth market analysis.

## Free Financial News Platforms

**Yahoo Finance** (https://finance.yahoo.com/) – Offers stock quotes, market data, portfolio tracking, and stock screeners at no cost.

**MarketWatch** (https://www.marketwatch.com/) – Provides latest stock market, financial and business news with personal finance advice.

**Investing.com** (https://www.investing.com/) – Features real-time stock quotes, economic calendars, streaming charts, and expert analysis.

**Seeking Alpha** – Great for investment ideas and crowd-sourced analysis from contributors.

## Specialized Stock Market Resources

**Briefing.com** (https://www.briefing.com/) – For 34 years, a trusted source for professional stock market analysis, live coverage of earnings, and pre/post-market updates.

**Benzinga** (https://www.benzinga.com/) – Known for original, accurate, and timely financial content with a focus on actionable trading ideas.

**MarketBeat** (https://www.marketbeat.com/) – Provides real-time analyst ratings, dividend information, earnings results, and financial headlines.

## Regional/Country-Specific Sources

**For Indian Markets:**
- **Economic Times** – Live stock market updates and business news
- **NDTV Business** – Market coverage and business stories
- **Zerodha Pulse** (https://pulse.zerodha.com/) – Aggregates financial news specifically for Indian investors

**For Asian Markets:**
- **CNYES** – Taiwan and Asian market focus
- **AASTOCKS** – Hong Kong stock market specialist

## Additional Formats to Consider

Beyond websites, you can also stay updated through:
- **Financial podcasts** (like The Meb Faber Show)
- **YouTube channels** (like Investor's Business Daily)
- **Twitter/X feeds** from financial journalists and institutions
- **Telegram channels** for real-time alerts

For the most comprehensive coverage, it's recommended to follow multiple sources to get a balanced, unbiased view of market movements.
